g.text: Fire doors of ONE floor — who may open them, who may close them

p.strong: Rules that make this survive restarts and failover

ul.li: Opening is cheap and safe: either tier may release; the edge never waits for the server to open its own floor.

Closing needs agreement: the edge re-locks only when the floor is clear, and refuses a stand-down while a room still reads critical (smoke ≥ 10 and CO ≥ 20) — stand_down_refused is sent back and the room is re-confirmed.

A controller that just started (restart, failover) has no memory of what it released. Every stand-down therefore carries floor_clear and relock, computed by the server from its own view; relock = true makes a fresh controller lock even though it never opened.
The ALL CLEAR lock is unconditional for a floor without an own fire, idempotent, and skipped by a controller that already wrote that state in this process.
A floor under server takeover is actuated directly through BuildSim; the same state machine applies, with the server playing both roles.

text.tspan: edge: FIRE confirmed on this floor
server: stand-down for the LAST confirmed room
(ALL CLEAR: no room confirmed or watched
→ ignored while an own fire is confirmed
